en.title: A cyst around a wisdom tooth

sentences.text: This wisdom tooth has not come through. It is still inside the jaw bone.
A thin, soft sac covers its crown. This is normal.
Sometimes fluid builds up in the sac, and it grows into a cyst.
It grows slowly and often does not hurt, so an X-ray often finds it first.
Most often, the surgeon takes out the cyst and the tooth together.
